# L1 policy status overrides / notes. Format: <ID> <STATUS|=> ;; note
GOV-015 = ;; Matched by CLAUDE.md § Git safety and git-workflow. Open related item: UNCERTAIN-L1-0002 — git-workflow runs high-risk operations (reset --hard, clean, force push, force-with-lease, branch deletion, rebasing shared history) "only when explicitly requested or required by an approved workflow"; whether the second alternative widens GOV-015's "explicitly requested" condition is LINK_UNCERTAIN (see ORPHAN_SWEEP_REPORT.md).
RUN-021 = ;; Matched by the caching skill and rules. Open related item: UNCERTAIN-L1-0001 — the caching skill permits invalidating before the mutation is known to succeed when it is a deliberate choice; whether this is a permitted exception or a relaxation of RUN-021 is LINK_UNCERTAIN (see ORPHAN_SWEEP_REPORT.md).
WF-019 = ;; Modality caveat: development-workflow states the startup-migration prohibition as 'Never' without the oracle's 'by default' qualifier; ci-cd and docker list automatic production migrations as anti-patterns (AVOID); the persistence commands forbid pointing database update/drop commands at Production.
WF-006 = ;; Matched as DEFAULT (verify); http-api and project-structure state related post-change verification steps with MUST strength, and EXTRA verification steps (local migration + seeder check, container verification, launch-profile consistency) are registered.
WF-010 = ;; Enforcement note: the code-reviewer agent disallows Write, Edit, MultiEdit and NotebookEdit; shell tools are not disallowed, so read-only behaviour for shell use rests on the instruction text; check-instructions.mjs (manual, not hook-run) verifies only that Write and Edit are disallowed.
DEP-025 = ;; Enforcement note: the PreToolUse gate (fail-closed) returns an 'ask' decision for npm/pnpm/yarn --force/-f/--legacy-peer-deps and 'npm config set' bypasses, so the command runs if the user explicitly confirms (EXTRA); the instruction text forbids the bypass.
DEP-003 = ;; Enforcement note: dependency commands are denied once and allowed on an identical retry within 30 minutes (EXTRA routing to add-dependency); the post-change check flags NuGet '*'/empty versions, npm '*'/'latest'/'x'/empty versions and prerelease versions ('allowed only when explicitly requested') as non-blocking feedback; version ranges are not detected and MSBuild-property versions are only flagged for manual confirmation.
DEP-004 = ;; Enforcement note: deny-once dependency gate as for DEP-003; the post-change check flags deprecated/denied packages (Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Polly, Polly.Extensions.Http, FluentValidation.AspNetCore, Serilog.Sinks.Elasticsearch) from manifest-policy.json; license and vulnerability checks rest on the add-dependency procedure.
ARC-001 = ;; Enforcement note: the PreToolUse gate returns 'ask' for dotnet project-reference add/remove commands (Reserved unless they implement the approved layout; EXTRA); after project-file edits the architecture check (check-architecture.mjs) reports outward references, production→test references, unknown roles and inner-role web/EF packages as non-blocking feedback.
RUN-010 = ;; Enforcement note: .editorconfig sets IDE0005 to warning (editor/analyzer); Directory.Build.props does not enable EnforceCodeStyleInBuild, so removal in changed files rests on the verify workflow.
ARC-020 = ;; Matched by CLAUDE.md § Decision control; L1 adds further Reserved categories (project reference graph, search/external storage/external identity infrastructure, project-wide conventions or abstractions, LangVersion/target framework, capability-selection change with ADR, database-provider variation) recorded as EXTRA.
GOV-006 = ;; Matched by CLAUDE.md and the persistence capability: relying on the database default collation for observable string semantics requires approval; the selection record must declare the string-comparison semantics (EXTRA).
GOV-017 = ;; Shared invariant. CLAUDE.md § Decision control defines Decided/Delegated/Reserved, the five-question test, the Decision Request fields and headless handling (oracle-linked); L1 adds recording of explicit-instruction approvals and accepted decisions as ADRs (architecture-decision), level-correct decision-file updates, decision summary lines pointing to the ADR, and a Decision Request on a missing capability facet (EXTRA).
GOV-018 = ;; Shared invariant. CLAUDE.md § Challenge questionable requests requires naming the concrete concerns and proposing an alternative before implementing, never silently rewriting the requirement; development-workflow checks the request against the challenge policy before writing code.
